_comment: Live channels and show categories for the DooFree addon. The addon fetches this file at runtime and caches it for a few hours, so editing and pushing it here is enough to fix a dead channel - no addon release, and viewers do not have to update. Keep the schema number as it is; the addon ignores a file it does not understand and falls back to the copy shipped inside the addon. 'name' is the label in the menu, 'title' is what shows while playing (optional, defaults to name), 'image' is an artwork filename from resources/media/doofree.
